root_cause: Prepublication review was identity-focused; company content automatically stamped final_copy_approved without a company-specific editorial quality policy, and distinct recommendation identifiers let repackaged TKI news appear repeatedly.
prevention_rule: Independent shared editorial contract checks readability, concrete entrepreneur pain and consequence, rejects internal memos/jargon, and compares last 21 days' actually published named story families before any company provider call. A rejected draft cannot bypass the gate.

evidence.observed_same_story: TKI Bouw en Techniek existing buildings subsidy repeated in three LIVE_PROVEN company posts
evidence.observed_oct19: 2833-character memo with cloud agents, BI refreshes and technical vocabulary
evidence.decision: A provider acknowledgement is not editorial approval.
evidence.test_state: Pending independent required CI verification after protected PR

outcome.target: Only relevant, novel, understandable MKB owner content may pass the company boundary; actual next post requires provider source/readback and post-release audit.
